WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine_w AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, m.store_id, SUM(v) v FROM mine m JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = m.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
rpt_w AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22 GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT COALESCE(a.fiscal_year,b.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(a.fiscal_week,b.fiscal_week) wk, COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) store_id, a.v mine, b.v rpt, ROUND(COALESCE(a.v,0)-COALESCE(b.v,0),2) diff
FROM mine_w a FULL JOIN rpt_w b ON a.fiscal_year=b.fiscal_year AND a.fiscal_week=b.fiscal_week AND a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(a.v,0)-COALESCE(b.v,0)) > 1
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
         (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
         AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                         AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date
              WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
  FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT cs.region, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS lfl_net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS lfl_net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY rank

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cs.region, d.fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
